title: Asian Flags Quiz: 20 Flags to Identify
description: Test your knowledge of Asian flags: identify 20 national flags from China, Japan and India to Bhutan and Uzbekistan. Free, fast quiz.
h1: Asian Flags Quiz: Can You Name These Flags?
intro: Asia is home to some of the most distinctive flags in the world, from Japan's simple red disc to the cedar of Lebanon. In this Asian flags quiz, you will look at 20 flags, one by one, and try to name the country. We start with well-known flags, such as China, South Korea and Thailand, then move on to flags from South Asia, Southeast Asia and the Middle East that are easy to confuse. The last questions feature Central Asian and Middle Eastern flags that challenge even experts. You have about five seconds per question. Every answer comes with a short explanation. Ready?

faq: Which Asian flags use a crescent?

Several Asian flags include a crescent, including those of Turkey, Pakistan, Malaysia, Singapore, Uzbekistan and the Maldives. The crescent has a long history in the Middle East and Central Asia and is often linked with Islam, though some flags use it for other reasons.
How can I tell the Middle Eastern flags apart?

Many Middle Eastern flags use the pan-Arab colors of red, green, white and black, which makes them look alike. Check the arrangement: Jordan has a red triangle and a star, the UAE has a red vertical band, and Iraq's flag carries green Arabic script in its white stripe.
What is the oldest flag in Asia?

Japan's Hinomaru, a red disc on white, is among the oldest national symbols in Asia, although it was only given formal legal status as the national flag in 1999. Many Asian flags are far newer, and several changed after independence in the 20th century.
